newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved in a narrow range, with the year-end approaching and members doing less business.

"Chinese banks usually do less business at year-end and this has made the trading volume decrease recently," said one trader. "But non-bank financial institutions including money brokerages run by the central bank have increased their trading, adding some liquidity to the market."
"With trading less active, the rates moved little," he added.
Traders expect the trend to continue in the short term unless there is major market-moving news.
